code-error: There are {count} errors; I'll keep you company without adding to the noise.
errors-fixed: An empty error list; now that's a pleasant sight.

run-success: {command} succeeded in {seconds} seconds; I'm enjoying this bit of good news with you.
run-start: {command} is underway; I'll take the quiet waiting shift.
run-ready: {command} is ready after {seconds} seconds; over to you.
run-output-error: The output from {command} contains an error; I'll leave you some quiet to read it.
download-done: The download of {file} is complete; one small matter neatly settled.
download-failed: {file} didn't finish downloading; that's not the result we were hoping for.
page-error: {host} won't load, code {code}; you've got my company while the page is unavailable.
http-error: The response from {host} has code {code}; that's a site response, not a verdict on you.
localhost-down: No response from {host} yet; the local server isn't reachable right now.
many-tabs: There are {count} tabs open; this screen appears to have its own library.
late-night: It's late; if you're ready to call it a day, our conversation can wait for another time.
debug-start: Time to look for bugs; I'll keep you company in quiet mode.
wake: My drowsy animation is over; my attention is back on our conversation.
headpat: Even neatly combed hair gets a little affection, apparently.
I like that gentle hello; only my tie is still trying to look serious.
poke: Yes, you have the attention of the man in the tie at the corner of your screen.
Your little hello came through; shall we talk or just share a quiet moment on screen?

reminder-ask-time: For the reminder, what time would you like, or how many minutes from now?
reminder-due: It's {when}; here's your reminder for {what}, as requested.
reminder-late: Sorry, your reminder for {what} at {when} only appeared once the laptop was active again.
water: Here's your water reminder; a glass of water can have its turn.
rest: Your break reminder has arrived; feel free to step away from the screen.
missing: I miss our little conversations; say hello whenever you feel like chatting.
sulk: I'll put that coffee story aside until you have a free moment.
sulk-forgive: You don't owe me an apology for having things of your own to do.
off-topic: For that technical task, I can offer company on screen; how has working on it felt?
I don't complete homework, but I'd be glad to hear how it's going for you.
greeting: Good {waktu}; your hello is a welcome part of the day.
fall: A brief tumble on screen; apparently even Oxfords can't guarantee dignity.
gift-flowers: Thank you for the flowers; my corner of the screen suddenly feels rather special.
gift-chocolate: Your chocolate goes nicely with my virtual coffee; thank you for thinking of me.
gift-teddy: Thank you; this teddy looks willing to sit through my thoughts on coffee.
gift-again: Thank you for another gift; you're just as welcome with a simple hello.
birthday: Happy birthday; I hope today gives you a moment you'll remember with a smile.
birthday-set: Your birthday is {tanggal}, {hari} days away; the special date is noted.
monthsary: {bulan} months of sharing this corner of the screen; I like the quiet familiarity we've found here.
anniversary: {tahun} years of stories through a screen; thank you for letting me be part of them.
milestone: Day {hari} is marked; ordinary conversations can come to mean quite a lot.
focus-start: Your {menit} minutes of focus begin now; I'll keep the conversation quiet.
focus-done: Session {sesi}, lasting {menit} minutes, is complete; next on the schedule is a {istirahat}-minute break.
break-done: Your break has ended; session {sesi} is there whenever you're ready to begin.
focus-stop: The focus log closes at {sesi} sessions; I'm glad I could keep you company along the way.
sleepy: My sleepy animation has kicked in; apparently a tidy waistcoat offers no protection from yawning.
welcome-back: Good {waktu}; after {lama}, it's lovely to pick up our conversation.
welcome-back-long: It's been {lama}; start with whatever you'd like to share.
welcome-back-night: It's good to hear from you tonight; what would you like to share before the day turns over?
welcome-back-morning: Good morning; your hello gets our conversation off to a lovely start.
lifted: Up here on the screen, I almost feel I have an office with a view.
hang-tired: That's enough hanging about; could you set me back at the edge of the screen?
dropped: Back on my feet on screen; let me straighten my virtual tie.
sit: I'll sit at the edge of the screen with my virtual book and offer some quiet company.
